:::{#thm-entropy-continuous}
#### Entropy of a continuous random variable

Let $X$ be a [continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv) with [probability density function](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) $\p(X=x)$.
Then

$$\entropyf{X} = -\int_{x \in \rangef{X}} \p(X=x) \log \p(X=x) \, dx.$$

:::

::: proof

Let $g(x) \eqdef \surprisalf{x} = -\log \p(X=x)$.
Then [LOTUS](#thm-lotus) gives

$$
\ba
\entropyf{X}
&= \E{\surprisalf{X}} && \text{(definition of entropy)} \\
&= \E{g(X)} && \text{(definition of } g \text{)} \\
&= \int_{x \in \rangef{X}} g(x) \cd \p(X=x) \, dx && \text{(LOTUS)} \\
&= -\int_{x \in \rangef{X}} \p(X=x) \log \p(X=x) \, dx. && \text{(definition of } g \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
